method: Sum edible gram weights times USDA per-100g composition, divide by servings. Generic USDA sauce/gnocchi profiles approximate branded products; red pepper approximates harissa micronutrients. Fortified yeast uses current Bob’s label with dry-yeast minerals for unreported nutrients. No cooking retention factors. Salt included. Smoked Italian turkey sausage approximates chicken Italian sausage, excluding its outlier iron value; optional xanthan and Parmesan are excluded. Missing USDA nutrient observations are not reported as zero.
omega3SourceNote: Recorded ALA (USDA 1404), EPA (1278), and DHA (1272) grams per 100 g from the same USDA SR Legacy source foods. Missing observations are excluded; this is a lower bound, not a complete total.
